verdict.rationale: GlitchTip docs confirm a CLI (Beta) for injecting debug IDs and uploading source maps for JS projects, and being Sentry-API-compatible suggests bundler plugins (e.g., Sentry webpack/vite plugins) could work similarly. However, evidence lacks detail on bundler plugin support specifically, CI integration examples, or independent hands-on confirmation that uploaded maps correctly resolve minified stack traces in production. Missing for 10: bundler plugin documentation/examples, CI pipeline walkthrough, and community/hands-on verification of symbolication working end-to-end.
